scenario: 社区搜索 (UGC 短文本搜索): 用户在社区平台搜索帖子、问答、评论等 UGC 内容。 核心指标是搜索相关性 (nDCG) 和点击率 (CTR)。 关注：语义匹配、query 理解、短文本召回、排序模型、LLM 在搜索中的应用。

papers.title: Adaptive Sparsity Optimization with Learnable Soft Top-K and Per-Term Thresholding for Efficient Retrieval
papers.authors: Wentai Xie, Parker Carlson, Shanxiu He, Tao Yang
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2610.02572v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Recent work on neural sparse retrieval has demonstrated strong relevance by leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs) for semantic term expansion. However, learned models paired with previous sparsification techniques still yield overly long document and query vectors partly due to a large LLM vocabulary, imposing a serious challenge to retrieval time and space efficiency. This paper proposes a scheme for optimizing model sparsity through a synergy of adaptive strategies, including learnable soft top-K, per-term thresholding, and FLOPs regularization to increase the sparsity of query and document vectors. Experimental results with Lion-SP model on the MS MARCO and BEIR datasets demonstrate that the proposed scheme can outperform the baselines by significantly reducing the average query and document lengths. Our scheme can achieve much shorter retrieval latency and lower storage cost while maintaining highly competitive relevance.
papers.summary: 针对大词表稀疏检索的词项膨胀问题，AdaSparse联合可学习软Top-K、逐词阈值与FLOPs正则化，兼顾向量长度与相关性。在MS MARCO和BEIR上，1B模型的查询、文档长度分别降至原来的31%和26.6%，BEIR效果仅下降0.74%，适合控制社区短文本召回的倒排索引成本。
papers.key_insight: 固定裁剪容易删掉复杂查询中的有效扩展词，逐词阈值和按输入长度设定的软上限提供两种互补约束。社区UGC搜索可先对实体词、口语词和长尾词分桶，比较nDCG、召回率、查询非零词项和索引体积，再决定是否采用这组训练正则；论文离线结果不能直接代表线上CTR收益。

papers.title: Learning Query Encoders Can Be Hard Even When Vector Retrieval Is Geometrically Easy
papers.authors: Anders Wikum, Nina Mishra, Amin Saberi, Tal Wagner
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2610.02749v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Efficient vector retrieval requires both a corpus geometry that supports retrieving the right documents through vector similarity, and a query encoder that can embed queries near their desired documents in the embedding space. Recent work has studied geometric capacity through the lens of the minimum embedding dimension needed to realize all top-$k$ answer sets of $n$ documents. We study a different notion of geometric capacity--the maximum recall achievable for a frozen document index--and explore whether learned query encoders can reach this ceiling. On several real-world retrieval benchmarks, we show that retrieval quality of single-vector query encoders often lies far below what the document indices can support.
  Motivated by this observation, we give theoretical evidence that learning query encoders can be computationally hard. In particular, we construct a retrieval task that (1) admits a query encoder with perfect recall which is
papers.summary: 论文区分冻结文档索引的几何容量与查询编码器可学习性，用排序SVM直接优化查询向量，估计可实现召回的下界。在BRIGHT、BEIR和LIMIT共20个数据集上，索引往往支持接近完美检索，但测试查询编码器多数未超过50%甚至25%召回，并给出统计查询学习模型中的指数级困难构造。
papers.key_insight: 检索失效可能来自查询映射没有学好，扩展向量维度或重建文档索引未必解决问题。社区短文本搜索可以在标注查询集上计算固定索引的理想召回下界，再与实际编码器比较，决定优先改进查询理解、难负例还是文档表征；SVM借助金标进行诊断，并不是可直接服务未见查询的线上检索器。

papers.title: Benchmarking Literature Retrieval for a Model Organism: A Dictyostelium Case Study
papers.authors: Yun Wang, Gad Shaulsky, Toma\v{z} Curk, Bla\v{z} Zupan
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2610.03130v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Biological literature retrieval systems are often developed and evaluated using broad biomedical corpora and general-purpose search tasks. However, many curated knowledge bases operate in narrower model-organism domains, where the literature is sparse and terminology is organism-specific. We introduce a retrieval benchmark from dictyBase for Dictyostelium, a model organism in cell and developmental biology. The benchmark consists of curator-generated biological queries linked to PubMed-indexed articles, together with structured gene annotations. Using this benchmark, we study three factors in niche biological retrieval: cross-encoder reranking, gene-aware query expansion, and abstract-only versus full-text retrieval. We report that reranking and gene-aware query expansion improve retrieval selectively: reranking is most useful when the model is well suited to biological evidence matching, whereas curated annotations help clarify compact
papers.summary: 作者用dictyBase策展查询测试领域检索，比较重排、基因同义词扩展与摘要或全文检索。在1656条查询上，BM25的MRR@10为0.593，MiniLM-L12降至0.541，MedCPT和BGE-Gemma则达到0.650和0.707，说明增加重排阶段并不保证相关性收益，领域匹配和实体词保留决定效果。
papers.key_insight: 模型规模和通用基准分数不能替代业务相关性评测，语义重排可能把精确实体证据排到后面。社区帖子、问答和评论搜索可保留BM25基线，构建品牌、缩写、术语和口语查询切片，再逐项测试混合召回、词典扩展与重排；优先核查关键实体是否保留，而不是默认跨编码器必然改善nDCG。

papers.title: Query-aware routing for Cross-lingual performance gains in Encoders
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2610.02875v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: Multilingual encoders can exhibit reduced retrieval effectiveness when queries and relevant documents differ in language, despite strong same-language performance. We investigate whether Finnish and Swedish cross-lingual retrieval can improve while preserving an encoder's existing same-language performance and document index. We combine a query-only low-rank adapter, trained against frozen document embeddings, with deterministic routing based on query and index languages. Cross-language queries use the adapter, while same-language queries use the original encoder. SampoTron, our fine-tuned low-rank (LoRA) adapter alongwith the Nemotron-3-Embed-1B model, improves average retrieval quality across six English, Finnish, and Swedish directions from 0.241 to 0.291 in normalized discounted cumulative gain (nDCG) at rank ten, a 20.9% relative gain on a sampled financial benchmark. All six cross-lingual directions improve, and routing preserves
papers.summary: 针对查询与文档语言不同导致的召回退化，作者冻结文档向量，仅训练查询侧LoRA，并按查询和索引语言做确定性路由。在英语、芬兰语和瑞典语的六个跨语言方向上，Nemotron-3-Embed-1B的平均nDCG@10由0.241升至0.291，相对增加20.9%，原有同语言路径保持不变。
papers.key_insight: 把适配限制在查询侧，可以保留文档索引并将跨语言改动控制在特定流量。社区UGC搜索可借鉴按语言分路由的设计，先用中文和外语混写的实体查询评估迁移，同时保留原模型回退；论文结果来自抽样金融数据，不能据此断言中文短文本也会获得相同收益，还需单独检验自然表达和混合语言。

papers.title: Page-Aware Retrieval-Augmented Generation for EvalLLM 2026: A Five-Variant Study on French PDFs
papers.abstract: Abstract: We study retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) for questions about French PDF documents when both the answer and its supporting document pages are evaluated. Five system variants add dense retrieval, rank fusion, reranking, and query decomposition to a BM25 baseline. On 595 challenge questions, the complete system scores 0.4450 MRR@10 and 0.4013 Recall@10, compared with 0.3430 and 0.2994 for BM25. Dense retrieval alone and a simple lexical--dense fusion both underperform BM25. Reranking improves the hybrid system, whereas adding query decomposition produces the largest further gain, with higher latency and more detected output artifacts. The complete system slightly exceeds the reported anonymous overall mean on two answer metrics but falls below it on most page-retrieval metrics. These results identify accurate page selection, rather than semantic retrieval in isolation, as the main opportunity for improvement in this setting.
papers.summary: 这项法语PDF检索研究在595条问题上比较五种流水线，逐步加入稠密召回、融合、重排和查询分解。完整系统的MRR@10与Recall@10为0.4450和0.4013，高于BM25的0.3430和0.2994；单独稠密检索及简单融合反而弱于BM25，查询分解带来的收益伴随更高延迟和输出问题。
papers.key_insight: 检索优化应以实际证据单元为目标，并逐阶段验证新增组件的边际价值。社区UGC场景可以把页面替换为帖子、评论或问答片段，比较正确内容定位和最终排序；复杂查询分解应仅用于受益查询类型，并加入延迟预算与异常输出检查，法语PDF结果不应直接当作短文本搜索的收益预估。

papers.title: The Memory Server in the Lab: 21 Studies, 125 Test Questions, +20.8 Percentage Points
papers.abstract: 作者对125条真实查询做三组评估，结合关键词与语义检索、首行3倍权重及同义词词典。困难组Recall@5从68.4%升至89.2%，MRR从0.564升至0.731；独立组42条查询最终Recall@5为88.1%。
papers.summary: 这篇独立工程实践用125条真实查询，评估全文与语义检索融合、首行搜索锚点和同义词词典。困难组Recall@5从68.4%升至89.2%，MRR从0.564升至0.731；42条独立查询组最终Recall@5为88.1%。这是小规模笔记检索实验，证据强度低于大规模公开基准或线上A/B。
papers.key_insight: 首行加权、词典桥接与检索融合权重都是低成本可试验的相关性杠杆。社区UGC搜索可将标题和评论正文区分权重，整理口语到领域实体的映射，再用独立查询集比较Recall和nDCG；作者的调参组与独立组结果应分开看，困难组的累计收益也不能归因于单个组件，更不能等同于CTR提升。
